description: This file defines the ScaffoldFilePath class used for managing file paths in a scaffolding context within a Drupal Composer plugin. It includes methods for creating source and destination paths, and for interpolating path data.

classes.name: ScaffoldFilePath
classes.description: A class for managing and manipulating scaffold file paths, including source and destination paths, with support for path interpolation.

methods.name: packageName
methods.description: Returns the name of the package containing the file.

methods.name: relativePath
methods.description: Returns the relative path to the file.

methods.name: fullPath
methods.description: Returns the full absolute path to the file.

methods.name: sourcePath
methods.description: Creates a ScaffoldFilePath object for a source file, given package info and source path.

methods.name: destinationPath
methods.description: Creates a ScaffoldFilePath object for a destination file, given package info and destination path.

methods.name: addInterpolationData
methods.description: Adds path data to an interpolator for use in string replacements.

methods.name: getInterpolator
methods.description: Returns an interpolator object pre-populated with this file path's data.
